parameters.description:
`nextcloud-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `nextcloud` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Nextcloud URL from your stored secrets and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds extra per-enrollment destinations via enrollment parameters.
parameters.summary: Relay a message through your own Nextcloud by posting a native Nextcloud payload to the UnitySVC gateway.

target_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's nextcloud targets
